name: Fantasy Earth

env.name: FE_ADVERTISE
env.description: Address Fantasy Earth clients reach this host on. Empty: POL_ADVERTISE, then 127.0.0.1.

env.name: POL_FE_WORLD
env.description: The world name in the game's world picker and on the Viewer profile. Empty: PlayOnline.

env.name: HIPPAULRING_TAG
env.description: Version of the published game image (docker-compose.ghcr.yml).

data.description: The cipher tables, computed from public constants. The published image carries them.
Spawn tables, item and skill parameters, map geometry and minimap art.

import.label: game data
import.hint: your Fantasy Earth install folder, the one holding DATA/ and FE_Client.dll

notes: The title plugin (fetitle) only fills the Viewer's profile screen; the game plays without it. The fedata tool needs Pillow on the host. The admin panel's world builder is reached through POL_ADMIN_GAME_FE_URL and _TOKEN (services/admingames.py), which this compose file does not set.
